name: Gizmo for Warug
summary: In Magram Village, Warug now wants a new target dummy to replace the wooden human he broke.

sections.title: The Gnome's Cart
sections.body:
Warug remembers a gnome who came to Desolace long ago with horses and a cart. Inside were curious things: some burned in different colors, while others moved though they were not alive. Warug killed the gnome, but not before the gnome made him laugh.

Warug kept his favorite thing from the cart, a wooden human that waved at him. He hit it and broke it. Now he wants an advanced target dummy to take its place, and expects one from anyone who is no enemy of the Magram.

faq.answer: Warug is a Magram centaur in Magram Village. He expects those he deals with to remain in the Magram's good standing.
Warug wants an advanced target dummy to replace the wooden human from the gnome's cart that he broke.

faq.q: Why does Warug want a target dummy?
aliases: why does warug want a dummy
faq.answer: Long ago, Warug killed a gnome who came to Desolace with a cart of strange, funny things. The gnome made him laugh, and Warug's favorite was a wooden human that waved at him. Warug hit it and broke it, so now he wants a new one.

faq.q: What comes before this in the Magram story?
aliases: what comes before gizmo for warug
faq.answer: Broken Tears comes before this in your dealings with the Magram.
